stem: Which sentence best describes a SIMILARITY between the stories “Do What You Can” and “How Six Sons Rescued Anansi”?
instruction: Use “Do What You Can” and “How Six Sons Rescued Anansi” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Both stories include a family who spends time together.

options.label: B
options.text: Both stories include characters who are rewarded for their efforts.

options.label: C
options.text: Both stories have characters who go on dangerous journeys.

options.label: D
options.text: Both stories use humor to send a message.
